title: Line refunds that add up to the charge
measures: Refunds a single order line as its share of what was charged (coupon and tax included) with whole-cent shares that add up exactly: refunding every line one by one gives back the charge, never a cent more (the gateway refuses) or less.
prompt: Support wants to refund a single item of an order instead of the whole order. Add refundLine(orderId, lineId) to the billing service.
